findings.title: Only 3 Additional Metrics Instead of 4
findings.issue: Task explicitly requires '4 additional metrics' but implementation shows only 3 (Total Created, Overall Completion, Current Streak). Watch Time was correctly removed due to data inaccuracy, but no replacement 4th metric was added.
findings.evidence: Line 168 comment: '/* Additional metrics - 3 smaller cards */'. Grid layout: 'grid grid-cols-3'. Only three metric cards rendered.
findings.consequence: Feature incomplete per task specification. User requested 'more options to the data' (original message #12), but removing Watch Time without replacement delivers fewer options, not more.
findings.correction: Add a 4th metric using available backend data: (A) 'Total Watch Time (All)' showing totalLectureSeconds with 'All Time' clarifier, (B) 'Avg Per Item' calculating totalLectureSeconds/totalLectures, (C) 'Processing Rate' showing successful completion percentage, or (D) restore Watch Time with 'Est.' disclaimer and proportional calculation.

findings.title: Overall Completion Rate Does Not Update Per Period
findings.issue: completionRate uses fullAnalytics?.completionRate for all three tabs without period-specific calculation. Backend provides only overall completion rate (backend/src/routes/analytics.js:92-93), not per-period data.
findings.evidence: completionRate: fullAnalytics?.completionRate || 0. Shows identical value across Day/Week/Month tabs (e.g., '85%' in all three).
findings.consequence: Violates task requirement that metrics 'update correctly when switching between Day/Week/Month tabs.' Users may think metric is stuck or broken despite 'Overall' label clarification.
findings.correction: Either: (1) Calculate period-specific completion by filtering lectures in period date range and checking their processing status, (2) Remove from Day/Week/Month tabs and display as standalone overall stat outside tabs, or (3) Accept current behavior if clarifying label 'Overall Completion' is deemed sufficient.

findings.title: Current Streak Does Not Update Per Period
findings.issue: calculateStreak() always uses full dailyActivity data (180 days), showing identical rolling streak value across all tabs. By definition, a streak counts consecutive days and cannot be period-bound.
findings.evidence: streak: calculateStreak(fullAnalytics?.dailyActivity || []). Shows same value in all three tabs (e.g., '7 days' in Day, Week, and Month).
findings.consequence: Violates task requirement that metrics 'update correctly when switching between Day/Week/Month tabs.' Appears redundant across tabs despite 'Current Streak' label clarification.
findings.correction: Either: (1) Show streak only in Day tab, hide in Week/Month, (2) Change to period-specific 'Active Days' metric counting days with activity in period (data.filter(d => d.lectures > 0 || d.digests > 0).length), or (3) Accept current behavior if clarifying label 'Current Streak' is deemed sufficient.
